channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Sudanese army air attack kills 13 in western Sudan: Rights group
item.description: 'Preliminary monitoring' shows women and children killed, homes destroyed in West Kordofan, says Emergency Lawyers.

item.title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of coalition forces fighting Houthis
item.description: Move comes as government forces withdraw from Red Sea coast to halt Houthi approach to interim capital Aden.

item.title: Iraq deploys army to stronghold of Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah
item.description: US pressure on Iraq to curb Tehran's influence leaves potential for direct confrontation with Iran-linked armed group.

item.title: Iran braces for natural gas shortages during winter energy imbalance
item.description: The gas infrastructure in Iran has suffered from underdevelopment and sanctions, and now damage from the war.

item.title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are gaining ground and their advance could have dangerous consequences, writes the BBC's security correspondent.

item.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
item.description: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial next year for deaths of her three children
item.description: The 36-year-old's first trial this year fell apart when a 12-person jury failed to reach a verdict.
